findings.title: New dependency runs an install script
findings.description: sentinel-fixture-telemetry is a new direct dependency and its lockfile entry sets hasInstallScript: true, so npm install will run code from this package on developer machines and CI runners.
findings.recommendation: Review the package's install script and publisher before merging, or install with --ignore-scripts and allowlist scripts that are needed.
